newsitem.title: USA: MasterCard will make postage stamps available at ATMs.
newsitem.headline: MasterCard will make postage stamps available at ATMs.

text.p: MasterCard International Inc. said Thursday it will make it possible for members of its Cirrus automated teller machine network to sell postage stamps at ATMs.
The service will be available in the United States in the second quarter.
Other products that may be offered over the next 18 months through the machines include telephone cards, travelers' checks, coupons and transportation cards, it said.
The MasterCard/Cirrus ATM Network is the world's largest, with nearly 315,000 locations in nearly 100 countries and territories.
